title: Behavior Map v1
description: D14 — the single declared map from a DADAIA.md section to the member(s) that operationalize it: EVERY core skill under dadaia_workspace/public/skills/*/SKILL.md and EVERY scoped AGENTS.md/*-AGENTS.md source under dadaia_workspace/public/{data,scaffold,templates}/ (never the projected instance path — see the two citation-path bugs cited in the enforcer). Supersedes rules-skills-map-v1 (retired, A10.3): the `skills` array + `justification` topic model is replaced by one row per member — a member (a skill name, or one scoped_agents_md path) maps to EXACTLY ONE row/section; a section MAY be owned by more than one row (A10.1). `anchor` carries T-050-20's future `<!-- behavior: ... -->` comment-anchor id inside the section body; null until that task lands. `hash_tuple` records the content hash of each side at the moment the row was last reviewed (A10.4) — the enforcer recomputes and compares, and a re-recording is a deliberate, reviewed act.

skill_md_line_ceiling.description: Ported from rules-skills-map-v1 unchanged (FR9/G12) — the declared line-count ceiling a SKILL.md's own content must stay within.

declared_overlaps.description: Ported from rules-skills-map-v1 unchanged (FR9/D4) — pre-cleared applyTo activation-glob overlap groups among non-universal skills.

section.description: The DADAIA.md section this row's member(s) operationalize, title-anchored: '§N <Section Title>' using the CURRENT numbering (never a bare '§N').

anchor.description: T-050-20's future <!-- behavior: <id> --> comment-anchor id inside the section body. Null until that task lands (D14/D15 — this schema carries the field now so that task is additive, never a schema migration).

skill.description: The single skill (under dadaia_workspace/public/skills/<name>/SKILL.md) this row owns, or null when the row is scoped_agents_md-only.

scoped_agents_md.description: Repo-relative POSIX SOURCE paths (never the projected instance path — the checkout-vs-instance bug this enforcer already guards against) under dadaia_workspace/public/{data,scaffold,templates}/ this row owns. May be empty when the row is skill-only.

section.description: sha256 of the section body (from its '## N. Title' heading up to, exclusive of, the next heading) at last review.

skill.description: sha256 of the skill's SKILL.md content at last review; null exactly when 'skill' is null.

scoped.description: sha256 of each scoped_agents_md source's content at last review, same order/length as scoped_agents_md.

recorded_by.description: The agent (or operator) who last reviewed and recorded this row's hash_tuple (A10.4).

recorded_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) this row's hash_tuple was last recorded.
